# Synthetic marketplace snapshot fixtures

These CSV files are synthetic contract fixtures for `k2.marketplace-snapshot.v1`.
They were authored from K2's provider-neutral staged-import requirements on
31 August 2026. They are not copied from Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop, contain
no customer or provider data, and do not establish parity with any provider's
current export format.

Before any adapter or provider-specific CSV dictionary is activated, K2 still
needs a redacted representative export from each real shop or approved current
provider documentation. Provider adapters must map into this normalized
contract without weakening its bounds, identity, review, or stock-separation
rules.
